common_limits: No Wine changes or tests edited; no runtime in this package.
No foreign objects, registry, system query, Set calls, sequential class scan, Windows disassembly, guard pages, or payload output.
Only two fixed class sentinels per included API; omitted NtQueryTimer has no sentinels.
Two independent runs A/B; no internal pattern loop. Same-value stores cannot be detected by byte-change counts.
form_policy: Explicit handle x ReturnLength variants; length boundaries are user-requested fixture expansions of source-tested named classes. Omitted valid/NULL/limited forms are partial coverage, not Windows ABI rejection.

log_contract.metadata_pattern_B: bitwise complement of each width-specific A initializer
log_contract.integer_values: ReturnLength and IOSB.Information always fixed-width lowercase hex strings, width 8 or 16 digits; NTSTATUS 8 digits
log_contract.pending: On immediate STATUS_PENDING set case_active false, emit outcome pending_unresolved and snapshot_state unavailable_pending with all D/IOSB/ReturnLength value/change observations null; retain static buffer lifetimes and ExitProcess(5) before another case. Parent records incomplete group; no group_complete.
log_contract.case_result_fields: record group case pattern name api class layout length_label reference_size length handle handle_access_mask metadata_kind return_length_mode outcome status exception setup_error snapshot_state return_length_width return_length_value return_length_changed_bytes iosb_size iosb_status_value iosb_status_changed_bytes iosb_information_width iosb_information_value iosb_information_changed_bytes iosb_changed_bytes data_changed_bytes data_changed_after_requested_length data_capacity
log_contract.case_begin_fields: record group case pattern name api class length handle handle_access_mask metadata_kind return_length_mode query_will_execute
log_contract.source_scope: No payload bytes or derived payload hashes, no arbitrary class selection, exactly the approved named classes plus fixed -1 and INT_MAX per included API. NtQueryTimer is excluded for missing test evidence.
log_contract.no_snapshot_reason: A pending operation may still write D or IOSB; do not race-read them and do not fabricate completion status.
